name: Dobar
text: Dobar, also written Dobhar, is the fanciful king of Siogar in the Fate of the Children of Tuireann. MacKillop notes the place as probably Sicily, with the Old Irish form Sieil for the same island. Dobar owned horses that travelled with equal ease over land and sea. Lug Lámfhota ordered the Children to fetch the horses and the royal chariot. They obeyed by killing Dobar with a poisoned spear. The tale belongs to the cycle of plundering quests assigned to the Tuireann brothers.
